subject: MAP: POC access gates & ownership — confirm milestones and owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: POC access gates & ownership — confirm milestones and owners

Hi Samantha — thanks again for a productive demo earlier. Per our call I wanted to capture the MAP milestone that we discussed for POC environment access so we have clear owners and dependencies. Draft below — please flag anything missing or incorrect.

POC access milestone (target: 2026-09-10)
- VPC peering established (GridLytics network team) — dependency: peering CID blocks and firewall rules
- IP allowlist (GridLytics IT) — dependency: list of egress IPs for the Redwood Dedicated nodes
- SSO / SAML integration (GridLytics SSO admin) — dependency: metadata XML & SP config
- Secrets/KMS access (GridLytics security + procurement) — dependency: KMS key policy and role for Redwood service account

Proposed owners from Redwood:
- Network & peering: Karthik Iyer
- SSO / SAML: Rishi Malhotra
- KMS / secrets access: Ben Carter (coordinate with procurement)

Next concrete asks for GridLytics to unblock the POC:
1) Share a contact for the network engineer who will own VPC peering and an initial CIDR proposal
2) Provide a primary SSO admin contact + SAML metadata stub
3) Confirm procurement lead for signing the limited KMS access addendum

I attached a short MAP draft and a CSV template for IP allowlist to speed up handoffs.

If this looks OK I’ll circulate a one-page MAP and lock the target milestone for 9/10 and align resources.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@gridlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: GridLytics IT <it-admin@gridlytics.com>, procurement@gridlytics.com
Date: 2026-08-24T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC access gates & ownership — confirm milestones and owners

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side:
- I’ll own the business side and coordinate procurement. I’m looping in IT (it-admin@gridlytics.com) to validate the networking items.
- Network contact: Diego Ramos (diego.ramos@gridlytics.com) — he can propose CIDRs and handle the peering ticket.
- SSO admin: Priya Shah (priya.shah@gridlytics.com) — she’ll send the SAML metadata by EOD on 8/25.
- Procurement: procurement@gridlytics.com — they will review the KMS addendum; please send the draft to that alias.

Two things to call out: our security team prefers a customer-managed KMS key for auditability. Can Redwood support that model for the POC? If not, we’ll need to escalate.

I’ll ask Diego to complete the IP template this week.

— Sam
Samantha Li
Director, Product | GridLytics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@gridlytics.com>, it-admin@gridlytics.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-26T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC access gates & ownership — confirm milestones and owners

Hi Diego / GridLytics IT team — quick technical notes to speed the peering and IP allowlist work: please see attached CSV for the minimal set of IPs we expect to use. A few specifics:
- For VPC peering: we recommend asymmetric NAT on our side; peering will require your acceptance of routes for 10.200.0.0/16 (example) — we can adjust to your CIDR plan.
- Firewall / security groups: allow outbound TCP 443 and 5222 (health checks) to Redwood egress addresses; inbound only for management plane is not required for the POC.
- SSO/SAML: Rishi will take the SP metadata. If you have an IdP test endpoint, include it in the metadata so we can validate in our staging environment.

Attachments: network-ports-iplist.csv; sso-saml-requirements.docx.

I can set up a 30-min handoff call with Diego + Priya tomorrow (8/27) if helpful.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@gridlytics.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@gridlytics.com>, it-admin@gridlytics.com, procurement@gridlytics.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC access gates & ownership — confirm milestones and owners

Thanks everyone — quick consolidation and next steps so we keep to the 9/10 milestone:
- Action: Diego (GridLytics) to send CIDR proposal + completed IP CSV — due 2026-09-03 — owner: Diego Ramos (cc: it-admin)
- Action: Priya (GridLytics) to send SAML metadata and IdP test endpoint — due 2026-08-25 (received) / follow-up if missing by 2026-09-03 — owner: Priya Shah
- Action: Procurement (procurement@gridlytics.com) to review KMS addendum — due 2026-09-07 — owner: procurement@gridlytics.com
- Redwood commitments: Karthik to open peering request and validate routing once CIDR received; Rishi to configure SP and test SSO after metadata; Ben to coordinate KMS addendum & sign-off process.

Regarding GridLytics' preference for a customer-managed KMS key: Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments. For this POC (hosted demo environment) we can document the controls and use an isolated key; if GridLytics requires a customer-managed CMK for audit reasons we should scope that as a near-term requirement and I’ll loop in our security lead. Please confirm procurement’s appetite so we can finalize.

I’ll push a one-page MAP (finalized) and the redlined addendum by EOD 9/2 and schedule a short runbook handoff call for 9/4. If we hit the dependencies on time, POC readiness target remains 2026-09-10.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf
